sections.title_en: Some further properties of Brownian motion
sections.title_zh: Brownian motion 的进一步性质

continuations.note: Completes the metric facts: d-convergence is uniform convergence on compact time intervals; P is complete and separable.
Part (a) is stated on PDF 270; part (b) and the proof continue on PDF 271.

key_objects.name_zh: 路径度量 d 的基本性质
key_objects.name_en: basic properties of the path-space metric d
key_objects.description: d(pk,p)→0 当且仅当 pk 在每个紧时间区间上一致收敛到 p；路径空间 P 在 d 下完备且可分。

key_objects.name_zh: 路径空间 P 的 Borel σ-代数 B
key_objects.name_en: Borel sigma-algebra B on path space P
key_objects.description: 由 P 的开集生成；因 P 可分，也可由开球生成。

key_objects.name_zh: cylindrical sets（柱形集合）
key_objects.name_en: cylindrical sets on path space

key_objects.name_zh: cylindrical σ-代数与 Borel σ-代数相同
key_objects.name_en: the cylindrical sigma-algebra equals the Borel sigma-algebra
key_objects.statement: C=B. Cylindrical sets are Borel, and open balls can be recovered from countably many rational-time constraints.

key_objects.name_zh: 路径测度的有限维 section
key_objects.name_en: finite-dimensional section of a path measure

key_objects.name_zh: 路径测度由全部有限维 sections 唯一确定
key_objects.name_en: path measure determined by all finite-dimensional sections
key_objects.description: 由 Lemma 2.1 及 cylindrical sets 的闭交性质，若两个路径测度的所有有限维 sections 相同，则两测度相同。

key_objects.name_zh: 路径空间概率测度的弱收敛
key_objects.name_en: weak convergence of probability measures on path space
key_objects.formula: ∫_P f dμ_N → ∫_P f dμ for every f∈C_b(P)

key_objects.name_zh: 概率测度序列的 tightness
key_objects.name_en: tightness of a sequence of probability measures
key_objects.formula: for every ε>0, there is compact K_ε⊂X with μ_N(K_ε^c)≤ε for all N

key_objects.name_zh: Prokhorov 紧性引理
key_objects.name_en: Prokhorov compactness lemma
key_objects.statement: 若 {μ_N} tight，则存在子列 {μ_Nk} 弱收敛到 X 上的概率测度 μ。

key_objects.name_zh: tightness + 有限维分布收敛推出路径测度弱收敛
key_objects.name_en: tightness plus convergence of finite-dimensional sections implies weak convergence
key_objects.statement: 若 {μ_N} tight，且每个 μ_N^(t1,...,tk) 都弱收敛到指定 μ_{t1,...,tk}，则 μ_N 弱收敛到 μ，且 μ^(t1,...,tk)=μ_{t1,...,tk}。

key_objects.name_zh: 路径集紧性的模连续性判据
key_objects.name_en: compactness criterion for closed subsets of path space
key_objects.description: 闭集 K 若在每个有限时间区间有统一模连续性，则 K 紧；本质上是 Arzelà-Ascoli 判据。

key_objects.name_zh: 由缩放随机游走构造 Wiener measure
key_objects.name_en: construction of Wiener measure from rescaled random walks
key_objects.statement: 路径测度 μ_N 在 P 上弱收敛；其极限正是 Wiener measure W。

key_objects.name_zh: 随机游走最大偏差的多项式尾界
key_objects.name_en: polynomial maximal tail bound for the random walk
key_objects.formula: sup_{n≥1} m({sup_{k≤n}|s_k|>λ n^{1/2}})=O(λ^{-p}) for every p≥2

key_objects.name_zh: 停止 martingale 的最大尾界
key_objects.name_en: maximal tail inequality for the stopped martingale

key_objects.name_zh: 缩放随机游走的统一模连续性概率界
key_objects.name_en: probabilistic modulus-of-continuity bound for scaled random walks

key_objects.name_zh: 通过 Hölder 型模连续性控制证明 tightness
key_objects.name_en: tightness via a Holder-type modulus of continuity
key_objects.description: 取 0<a<1/2，用 dyadic δ=2^{-k}、Lemma 3.2 与求和控制得到各有限 T 上的统一增量界，再交叠 K(T) 并用 Lemma 2.4 得到共同紧集。

key_objects.name_zh: 有限维分布由中心极限定理收敛到 Wiener sections
key_objects.name_en: finite-dimensional distributions converge to Wiener sections by the CLT
key_objects.description: 各增量 S_{t_j}^{(N)}-S_{t_{j-1}}^{(N)} 由多维 CLT 收敛到相应 Gaussian；独立增量结构给出整个向量的有限维分布收敛。

key_objects.name_zh: Donsker invariance principle
key_objects.name_en: Donsker invariance principle
key_objects.statement: 对 iid、均值 0、协方差 I 的平方可积 R^d 值增量，按同样的时间/空间缩放和线性插值构造的路径测度也弱收敛到 Wiener measure。

key_objects.name_zh: Brownian motion 的三个不变性
key_objects.name_en: three invariance properties of Brownian motion
parts: o(B_t) is Brownian for orthogonal o
B_{t+σ0}-B_{σ0} is Brownian for fixed σ0≥0

key_objects.name_zh: Brownian 路径的 Hölder 正则性与粗糙性
key_objects.name_en: Holder regularity and roughness of Brownian paths
